items.title: Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan, Egypt condemn Iranian attack on Bahrain - as it happened

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan, Egypt condemn Iranian attack on Bahrain - as it happened.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔、约旦、埃及谴责伊朗对巴林的袭击——事件经过。

sentences.en: Iran has targeted airbase in Bahrain in latest resumption of strikes since september The state-run Bahrain news agency is also carrying the statements of each country in the region responding to Iran’s actions targeting their Gulf neighbour this morning.
sentences.zh: 伊朗针对巴林的空军基地发动了自9月以来的最新一轮袭击。巴林官方通讯社今晨还报道了该地区各国针对伊朗针对其海湾邻国的行动所发表的声明。

sentences.en: Jordan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar have all strongly condemned the attack and expressed solidarity with Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 约旦、埃及、沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔均强烈谴责此次袭击，并表示声援巴林。

sentences.en: The Kingdom affirms that the Iranian attacks constitute a violation of international law and the principles of good neighborliness.
sentences.zh: 沙特王国申明，伊朗的袭击行为违反了国际法和睦邻友好原则。

sentences.en: The Kingdom stresses the importance of an immediate halt to the blatant Iranian attacks on the countries of the region, and of taking serious steps towards achieving security and stability for the countries of the region and their peoples.
sentences.zh: 沙特王国强调，必须立即停止伊朗公然袭击该地区各国的行为，并采取严肃措施，为该地区各国及其人民实现安全与稳定。

sentences.en: The continuation of these attacks represents a dangerous escalation that will complicate efforts to contain the tension and undermine political and diplomatic endeavors aimed at achieving security and stability in the region.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击的持续发生代表着局势的危险升级，将使缓和紧张局势的努力复杂化，并破坏旨在实现该地区安全与稳定的政治和外交努力。

sentences.en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed the Kingdom of Bahrain’s strongest condemnation of the continued Iranian aggression against its territory, including the attack launched today, Sunday, November 15, 2026, by drones that were intercepted and destroyed by air defense systems in the Kingdom’s airspace.
sentences.zh: 外交部表示，巴林王国最强烈地谴责伊朗持续侵犯其领土，包括2026年11月15日（星期日）今天发生的无人机袭击事件，这些无人机在巴林王国领空被防空系统拦截并摧毁。

sentences.en: This comes two days after a similar attack at dawn on Friday, November 13, 2026, by two drones that were also intercepted.
sentences.zh: 在此之前两天，即2026年11月13日（星期五）凌晨，也曾发生过类似的袭击，当时有两架无人机被拦截。

sentences.en: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard explicitly claimed responsibility for these attacks.
sentences.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队明确宣称对这些袭击负责。

sentences.en: The Ministry praised the efficiency, vigilance, and capability of the Bahrain Defense Force in confronting today’s attack and its complete readiness to deter any aggression.
sentences.zh: 国防部赞扬巴林国防军在应对今日袭击方面的效率、警惕性和能力，以及其完全做好准备以威慑任何侵略的态势。

sentences.en: The Ministry considered these attacks a resumption of Iran’s heinous aggression against the Kingdom and countries in the region , disregarding the provisions of international law and the principles of the UN Charter.
sentences.zh: 该部认为，这些袭击是伊朗无视国际法规定和《联合国宪章》原则，再次对沙特王国和该地区各国发动的罪恶侵略。

items.title: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back

sentences.en: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back.
sentences.zh: 限制煤矿工人接触有毒粉尘的法律面临被废除的风险。

sentences.en: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease.
sentences.zh: 接触二氧化硅粉尘的煤矿工人患黑肺病的风险更高。

sentences.en: Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.
sentences.zh: 尽管几十年来一直在呼吁，但旨在监管有毒粉尘的新举措正面临威胁。

sentences.en: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others.
sentences.zh: 在一些州，民主党人掌控了此前处于分裂状态的立法机构，而在其他州，他们削弱了共和党的统治地位。

sentences.en: Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.
sentences.zh: 议程上的议题：增加医疗保健的获得机会，对教育券施加新的限制。

items.title: 160 questions, only one wrong: top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating

sentences.en: 160 questions, only one wrong: top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating.
sentences.zh: 160道题只错一道：韩国税务考试最高分考生承认使用人工智能作弊。

sentences.en: Fears for national college entrance exam next week as test taker admits sending photos of questions to AI tool The marks attained by the top scorer ⁠on South Korea’s national exam for aspiring tax accountants this year seemed too good to be true.
sentences.zh: 由于一名考生承认将试题照片发送给人工智能工具，人们对下周举行的国家高考感到担忧。今年韩国有志成为税务会计师的考生在国家考试中取得的最高分似乎好得令人难以置信。

sentences.en: On Sunday, sceptics were ⁠proven right when he ⁠confessed to ​using generative AI to cheat.
sentences.zh: 周日，当他承认使用生成式人工智能作弊时，怀疑论者被证明是正确的。

sentences.en: The scandal has followed months of speculation after he scored near-perfect marks on hundreds of questions over two exams ⁠taken in April and July.
sentences.zh: 在4月和7月进行的两次考试中，他在数百道题目上获得了接近满分的分数，此后数月一直有各种猜测，最终引发了这场丑闻。

sentences.en: It has also raised the stakes for organisers of South Korea’s annual college entrance exam this Thursday.
sentences.zh: 这也增加了本周四韩国年度高考组织者的压力。

items.title: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya

sentences.en: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya.
sentences.zh: 世界最高法院将裁定缅甸是否对罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝。

sentences.en: International court of justice has never before found a state guilty of genocide, and ruling will have implications for case against Israel The world’s top court will deliver a judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a landmark case that will set a critical 21st-century benchmark for the gravest of all international crimes.
sentences.zh: 国际法院从未判定任何国家犯有种族灭绝罪，而该裁决将对针对以色列的案件产生影响。本周，世界最高法院将就缅甸是否对罗兴亚少数民族犯有种族灭绝罪作出裁决，这是一起具有里程碑意义的案件，将为所有最严重的国际罪行设定一个至关重要的21世纪基准。

sentences.en: The closely watched judgment could become one of the most significant moments in international law since the end of the second world war.
sentences.zh: 备受瞩目的这一判决可能会成为二战结束以来国际法领域最重要的时刻之一。

items.title: World leaders head to Asia for back-to-back diplomatic summits

sentences.en: Tussle for influence as trade, tech and regional security to take centre stage in China, Philippines and Cambodia meetings World leaders will fly in to Asia for back-to-back high-level summits this week against the backdrop of the tussle for influence between the superpowers China and the US.
sentences.zh: 在贸易、科技和地区安全成为中国、菲律宾和柬埔寨会议的焦点之际，争夺影响力的大戏上演。本周，世界各国领导人将飞往亚洲，出席一系列高规格峰会，而这一切都将发生在中美这两个超级大国争夺影响力的背景之下。

sentences.en: Beijing will have the home advantage when it welcomes Donald Trump to its southern technology hub of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders’ meeting.
sentences.zh: 当北京方面在南方科技中心深圳迎接唐纳德·特朗普出席亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议时，将享有主场优势。

sentences.en: It starts two weeks after the US leader lost midterm elections .
sentences.zh: 它始于美国总统在中期选举失利两周后。

sentences.en: Philippines’ Carmelle wins first Eurovision contest in Asia.

sentences.en: Filipino entry, pop and rap song Sobra-Sobra, takes 19-year-old to victory at grand final in Bangkok Carmelle Collado has won the first Eurovision song contest Asia, taking the Philippines’ entry, Sobra-Sobra , to victory in Bangkok on Saturday night, at the first regional edition of the contest to be staged outside Europe.
